original_content_full: The paper "A Non-Photorealistic Rendering Technique for Art-directed Hatching of 3D Point Clouds" by Ronja Wagner, Ole Wegen, Daniel Limberger, Jürgen Döllner, and Matthias Trapp was accepted for publication and presentation at the 17th Internation Conference on Computer Graphics Theory and Applications (GRAPP 2022). The conference will take place as virtual-only event February 6-8, 2022.
